class.tecnico.name: Life-support technician
class.tecnico.desc: Balanced. Uses less oxygen. Wrench, nail gun and a breach sealer.
class.infiltrado.name: Infiltrator
class.infiltrado.desc: Silence and blows from behind. Knife, dart pistol and dampers in the legs. Less health.
class.medico.name: Field medic
class.medico.desc: Healing is 50% more effective. Scalpel, pistol and a well-stocked kit.
class.soldador.name: Heavy welder
class.soldador.desc: Lots of health and armour, but you can be heard coming. Emergency axe and plasma welder.
class.hacker.name: Hacker
class.hacker.desc: Hacks with an edge and lives on energy. Stun baton, arc pistol, EMP grenades and a drone.
class.eco.name: Dissident Echo
class.eco.desc: A clone who listened too much. Resists Mental Noise and senses through walls. Resonance dagger and Choir node.
